Jaah
Delegate engineering work to AI agents with reviews, records, and rules
Coding agents write the code. Jaah makes it production-grade. It lets teams delegate engineering and related work to AI agents while keeping control over processes and outcomes. Jaah uses the same coding agent with added guardrails like reviews, audit records, permissions, and workflow rules that integrate with tools such as Jira and Slack. It sizes work, schedules recurring tasks, enforces standards across repositories, and returns merged, reviewed changes with reports. Jaah supports startups to enterprises on machines you choose.

Shipfound
Get your product named by ChatGPT, Claude Code, or Codex
Shipfound turns Claude Code or Codex into your growth engineer. It audits your site and accounts it can access, then handles the work: fixing your site for Google and AI search, creating content pages and indexing as pull requests, and filling in directory listings for you to submit. It counts visitors and AI crawlers like GPTBot and PerplexityBot, asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, and Claude your buyers' questions to see if they name you, and checks every change on your live site. Plans include a free option, Starter at $49/month, and Growth at $99/month.

QRFLOW
Generate, edit, and track QR codes with AI chat bots and MCP server
QRFLOW.codes runs as an MCP server, so assistants like Claude or ChatGPT can create and manage codes for you. It also offers a fast, no-signup QR code generator with live previews and instant PNG or SVG downloads. You can create link, Wi-Fi, vCard, phone, SMS, and other codes, then save them to a dashboard to edit destinations later. The premium plan lets you make every code dynamic, add your own domain, embed logos, and access detailed scan analytics with CSV export and bulk generation.

Furlyo
Run your grooming or daycare shop with unified booking, CRM, and POS
Furlyo is an all-in-one platform for pet grooming and daycare shops that replaces fragmented tools with a single pet-centric workflow. It offers 2-tap online booking with deposits to reduce no-shows, a CRM that stores full pet history, notes, and photos, integrated retail POS, automated marketing, and real-time analytics. Teams manage calendars, check-ins via QR codes, payments, and review requests in one place, while integrations with Stripe, Xero, QuickBooks, Google Calendar, and Mailchimp keep operations in sync.
